tools.name: orchestrator_start
tools.description: Create a durable engineering run and return its ID. Does not dispatch a worker. Then announce the first agent/task and call orchestrator_stage in the foreground.

approved_handoff.description: Absolute JSON handoff path, only with explicit user approval

tools.name: orchestrator_stage
tools.description: Run exactly ONE workflow stage in the foreground. The host displays its native running indicator. Announce the agent, task and expected output before calling. Returns a structured result plus the next stage. Do not wrap several stages in one call.

tools.name: orchestrator_status
tools.description: Deterministic compact status and next action. Makes no model calls.

tools.name: orchestrator_recap
tools.description: Deterministic engineering recap from persisted reports, journal, diffs and test evidence. Makes no model calls. Use 'developer' when the user asks how/why.

tools.name: orchestrator_interrupt
tools.description: Persist an interruption, terminate the active process session/descendants, verify termination and preserve changes. Never claim a worker stopped without this result.

tools.name: orchestrator_amend
tools.description: Persist a user requirement or implementation amendment. Interrupts active work first when needed, invalidates affected downstream evidence and leaves the run paused for resume. Set architect_review for requirement/design changes.

kind.description: Requirement changes replan; corrections stay bounded

tools.name: orchestrator_resume
tools.description: Resume a paused run after interruption/amendment. Does not execute a stage. An optional host must match the persisted controlling host.

tools.name: orchestrator_reconcile
tools.description: Reconcile an uncertain attempt only after its process session is proven stopped. Clears stale retry sessions. Fails closed when ownership is uncertain.

tools.name: orchestrator_runs
tools.description: List recent durable runs so a new chat can attach to existing work.
